steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Dolly the Sinner, are you awake?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: There is a mission for you. Please get ready.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the cell has already been unlocked.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I've got to go deal with other Bureau business.
Before Nightingale disappears in sight, the person curled up in the cell starts moving.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: ...Huh?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Urgh!!
Being just woken up by Nightingale, Dolly immediately gains her energy at the sight of you.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Chief! You're finally here!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Heh heh... Time for the mission, right?! I was almost bored to death for the past few days!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: What are we waiting for then?! Let's go!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: The sooner we finish, the sooner I can prepare for the Eastside Baseball League!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Right, Chief?!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: You liar! I thought we agreed?!
It isn't really a mission.
Think of it as the 31st... test.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Tsk. Whatever. I'm sure I'll be able to control myself.
That couldn't be better. Oh, and this is for you.
You toss the baseball bat to Dolly, who leaps up eagerly like an excited puppy, snatching it midair before nuzzling it against her face affectionately.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I miss you so much! I couldn't even have a good night's sleep without you.
Looks like you're in high spirits though.
Dolly glares at you.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: By the way, can we get there by motorcycle?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I haven't enjoyed that feeling of speeding along for a while!
You shake your head and pat your pocket.

options: Maybe we don't need a motorcycle to get speeding

choices.text: Maybe we don't need a motorcycle to get speeding

steps.content: The Rust's rundown scene recedes swiftly on the sides. After driving through a high-risk zone, you switch on the autopilot mode.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Well... I feel kind of nostalgic looking at this place.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I had no fear for anyone back then, and I ended up almost killing myself in a pile of Corruptors.

options: What were you doing at the Rust?

choices.text: What were you doing at the Rust?

steps.content: Trying to make ends meet?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Now you're underestimating me. Why would I ever do such a thing?

steps.speaker: Navigator
steps.content: Upcoming left turn. Rough road conditions ahead. Please fasten your seat belt.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Looks like the Bureau's sat nav isn't that familiar with the Rust after all.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: We're gonna run into Corruptors going this way.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Roarrrr—!
Before Dolly finishes her sentence, a Corruptor charges out from behind a garbage pile. You hurriedly switch the car to manual control and accelerate at full speed.
The Corruptor's speedy with a good hearing. When it notices the sound, it rushes towards you.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: It's a mutant and a tough one. Should I get out to deal with it?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Oh... Okay, then. Good luck.
You press down the gas hard, but the Corruptor doesn't get any slower and continues to follow behind.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: You look like you're struggling. Since you won't let me fight, I'll drive for you!
She reaches out from the back seat and grabs the sat nav.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Don't worry—I know this area like the back of my hands.
She draws a few lines on the sat nav and frowns, then presses the confirm button.

steps.speaker: Navigator
steps.content: The route has been changed. Direction revision in progress.
The car leaps high above the piles of trash in the Rust, crashes through the mountain of trash, and lands on the other side of the gulch.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Ohhhh. Exciting! All we need to do is to trick that big idiot!
The Corruptor is left well behind while you continue onward toward your destination.
Was this how you got to Eastside?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Of course.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: This is the fastest and most convenient way for Syndicans to get into Eastside.
Why would you do that? Weren't you worried about the West District Regulations?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: West District Regulations... Psst. A whole bunch of nonsense.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Even if I did get caught in Eastside and deported, there's really nothing for me to lose.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: The approval takes such a long time and the road fees are so incredibly expensive. Most of all, I simply couldn't wait any longer.
For what? The baseball game?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Of course. I want to get to the top stage and play against the strongest players. There was no match for me in Syndicate anymore.
Her answer is so definite and without any hesitation.
But Eastside and Syndicate are like worst enemies. Aren't you worried you're going to be condemned by Syndicans?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Pfft... Hahaha.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: To be honest, I had never thought about it at all.

options: ...Well, that is definitely an answer you'd give.

choices.text: ...Well, that is definitely an answer you'd give.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: If there has to be a reason... I wanted to show the Eastsiders that Syndicans can be great baseball players too.
An electronic voice interrupts her words.

steps.speaker: Navigator
steps.content: We're at the destination. Please exit.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Well, the Bureau certainly has high quality vehicles. My motorcycle would definitely have been torn to pieces if I drove it like that.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: You haven't forgotten our agreement, have you?
You nod.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Ha—
The Corruptors seem to have sensed humans and begin to gather around you.
In the face of the Corruptors coming at the vehicle, you give Dolly the order.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Take this!
Before you even finish speaking, Dolly dashes like a sharp arrow piercing straight into the center of the Corruptors.
She swings the metal bat in her hand as hard as she can, knocking down the Corruptors one after another.
But even someone as strong as Dolly simply cannot fight against the Corruptors without using her ability.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Tsk... I thought I could easily win the bet.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I hope you didn't set me up for something. Stay away from me, I'm going to clear them all up.

options: Just don't get out of control.

choices.text: Just don't get out of control.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Okay... Okay...

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I won't...

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I won't... Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!
The amount of Corruptors isn't decreasing at all. After ordering her not to attack you, you begin to step back.
Dolly begins to release her energy as she did in the Bureau's tests.
The only difference is that she has a baseball bat in her hand this time.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Aaahhh—
Like a fighting machine that never gets tired, she weaves through the Rust with her all-destructive power.
She gets faster and faster, to a speed so fast that your eyes can barely catch up.
This is the first time you watch Dolly in battle so closely.
It's also the first time you feel Dolly's power tearing your consciousness so fiercely.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Die...!
With each swing of her bat, the shackles binding her gets torn apart even more.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: ...I... won't go out of control...
For Dolly, this is no longer a fight against the Corruptors, but against herself.
You notice Dolly's twisted face as she desperately tries to control her emotions.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Why...?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Isn't it working... Ahhh!
Unfortunately, even though she remains more conscious than ever, her body is swinging the bat uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Stop... Come on... Stop!
The situation is getting out of hand very quickly. You have to do something.
You try hard to control the shackles to disable Dolly's ability.
But Dolly is so fast that you have to release the shackles in a hurry.
You decide to trust Dolly.
But as the figure speeds toward you, you have no choice but to change your plan and release the shackles.
Her body pauses for a moment. This isn't really a disruption.
She shakes her head and continues swinging her bat at you. To avoid her attack, you have to keep on using the shackles.
You keep trying. It's somewhat effective, but not enough to get her out of the state.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Aaah... Aaah... Dodge!!
Dolly still has no control of her body, though she can now say complete words.
You shut your eyes to compose yourself and try one last time.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Ah... Ah!!
Her yell is getting closer and closer, like a hurricane swooping down, about to annihilate you from the earth.
All the sounds halt.
You feel the cold metal of the baseball bat on your forehead.
You open your eyes, only to see Dolly freeze like an ice sculpture before you, panting with her mouth wide open, unable to make a sound.
As with the last mission, you get Dolly out of the state just in time. It was so close.
Your ability has more to do with this than your emotions.
You reach out and take the baseball bat stopping at your forehead back to Dolly's hands.
Baseball is Dolly's life.
You don't know how to comfort her, but you believe it's better to tell her the truth than to keep her in the dark.
Once again, you tell her the grave truth—

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Sob...
Upon learning the news, Dolly does not become berserk. She simply sits helplessly on the ground, like a puppet with broken strings.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Then... what... what should I do?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Baseball... playing baseball is the only thing I can do. If I can't play... I might as well just die.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I... remember it now.
She hugs her knees and weeps uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: During the battle just now, I remembered why I... was like that.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I was attacked by a Corruptor... on the way to Eastside. I desperately swung my bat to fight them when I was about to die, which was when I got this ability.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Swinging the bat activates my ability.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I'm just a... bat swinging machine!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Haha... What a fool I was. How could I forget something so important... I even wrote a letter for myself to read three years from then... Hahaha.
Dolly sat on her knees, her eyes unfocused.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I'm such an idiot who can do nothing other than swinging the bat nonstop.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: ...Like a robot, getting faster... and faster with each swing.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Chief... You won. I can never go back to the stadium again. I'll only destroy the place with my bat.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: The more I swing the bat, the further I am from the stadium.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Just let me... rot away like this.
She's probably exhausted from activating her ability, or maybe she just needs some time to herself.
After getting into the vehicle, Dolly curls up in the back seat and falls sound asleep before long.

steps.speaker: Navigator
steps.content: You have a call from "Nightingale." Please answer.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, are you still around Eastside?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Great.
Seems like Nightingale lets out a sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: There's a Corruptor attack at the Eastside Stadium in the middle of a game, and the FAC squad can't get all the spectators out. They need our help.
Hold on, we'll be right there.

steps.speaker: Navigator
steps.content: Destination changed to "Eastside Stadium."
After hanging up, you shoot a glance at Dolly in the back seat, and at the baseball bat she's clutching tightly in her hands even while asleep.
Perhaps, there's still a chance.
